show.description: The Mother Crown is a powerful family drama about love, sacrifice, and betrayal. Sangeeta, who raised three sons into a world-renowned doctor, businessman, and writer, finds her motherhood questioned when strangers claim she kidnapped them 25 years ago. As her sons turn against her, shocking truths and hidden powers surface—revealing that their entire success may not be their own, but the result of a mother’s secret crown.
